capabilities: Chat with an autonomous tool-calling agent about vault notes
Search, read, and traverse notes via vault tools (backlinks, outgoing links, folders)
Propose note edits as unified diffs that require approval before writing
Run scheduled background tasks like daily summaries and weekly reviews
Configure multiple LLM providers with per-provider keys, base URLs, and models
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Remote LLM providers bill API usage directly to the user; the plugin itself is free. Detailed disclosures cover network use, vault read/write access, and clipboard behavior.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI assistant that can search the vault, reason over notes, and propose note changes for review inside a chat.

relations.evidence: Multiple providers — OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Qwen (Alibaba), Kimi (Moonshot), Zhipu (GLM), MiniMax, OpenRouter, Ollama (local)
